title: Lightly Smoky Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Syrian dish featuring allspice berries and a smoky flavor, these lamb kebabs are crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. They are also keto-friendly, making them a great option for a low-carb diet.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and ground allspice berries.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the kebabs are cooking, prepare the deglaze-fond by reducing 1/4 cup of beef broth over high heat until almost syrupy.
After flipping the kebabs, brush them with the deglaze-fond to add a rich, smoky flavor.
Once the kebabs are cooked, let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a side of roasted vegetables or a salad.
